items.title: 2.5.1.2 Function Parameters and Return Values (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of parameters and return values (PDF 46-47).

blocks.text: Functions kai parameters le sakte hain aur return ke zariye result (nateeja) wapas de sakte hain.
Misaal: do numbers jorne wala function banayein.
def add (a , b) : return a + b

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"def add (a , b) :": def keyword se naya function banta hai. Function ka naam add hai aur brackets mein do parameters (function ko milne wali values ke naam) a aur b hain.
"return a + b": function a aur b ka sum (jor) wapas (return) karta hai. Body sirf ek line ki hai, is liye colon ke baad usi line mein likh di gayi.
Yeh code sirf function banata (define karta) hai, usay call nahi karta. Istemal ke liye neeche alag line mein print(add(2, 3)) likhna hoga, jo 5 print karega.
Output: is akele code se kuch print nahi hota, kyun ke function define hua hai magar call nahi hua.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Ek hi function ko alag alag arguments ke saath kai baar call kar ke (bula kar) ek hi code alag alag inputs ke liye istemal ho sakta hai: add(2, 3) = 5, add(10, 20) = 30.

blocks.prompt: add(7, 8) kya wapas karega, aur print(add(7, 8) * 2) kya print karega?
blocks.explanation: add(7, 8) 15 wapas karta hai; 15 * 2 = 30, to 30 print hota hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program add function ko do numbers de kar return se un ka sum (jor) wapas leta hai. first aur second ki values badal kar Run karein aur dekhein wapas aane wala result kaise badalta hai.

first = 12
second = 5
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
result = add(first, second)
print("add(first, second) =", result)
print("Result ka double =", result * 2)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"first = 12" aur "second = 5": do variables bante hain jin mein numbers rakhe hain.
"def add(a, b):": add naam ka function banta hai jo do parameters a aur b leta hai.
"return a + b": function a aur b ka sum (jor) wapas bhejta hai.
"result = add(first, second)": function call hota hai; a ko 12 aur b ko 5 milta hai, aur wapas aane wala 17 result mein rakh liya jata hai.
"print("add(first, second) =", result)": result ki value screen par dikhati hai.
"print("Result ka double =", result * 2)": result ko 2 se zarb (multiply) kar ke dikhati hai: 17 * 2 = 34.
Output: pehli line "add(first, second) = 17" aur doosri "Result ka double = 34".
Khud try karein: second = 8 kar ke Run karein: ab "add(first, second) = 20" aur "Result ka double = 40" aayega.

items: return result wapas deta hai; ek function kai baar bulaya ja sakta hai.
